watches.name: Della Balda 95th Anniversary Edition
watches.description: The Della Balda 95th Anniversary Edition celebrates Delbana’s heritage while embracing modern refinement. Named after founder Goliardo Della Balda, this limited edition reflects the enduring spirit of the collection. The polished yellow gold PVD stainless steel case frames a silver sunburst guilloché pattern dial, enhanced by applied arrow-shaped indexes and Arabic numerals. The historic Delbana logo at 12 o’clock and the absence of a date window reinforce its vintage character. The commemorative case back is engraved with a tower within a crest drawn from the brand’s archives and marked “One of 95,” underscoring its exclusivity. Paired with a brown handmade Italian leather strap and protected by a domed sapphire crystal, it blends vintage appeal with modern durability. Powered by the reliable Swiss automatic SW200-1 movement, it is a refined tribute to 95 years of independent watchmaking. The Delbana Della Balda 95th Anniversary Edition is limited to 95 pieces per variation and is now available for purchase. First orders are currently being shipped, with deliveries ongoing from end of May 2026.

watches.name: Rotonda
watches.description: DESCRIPTION Defined by harmonious proportions and refined aesthetics, the Rotonda blends Swiss tradition with contemporary sophistication. Inspired by Delbana’s earliest models, it celebrates the enduring pleasure of mechanical watchmaking and the brand’s commitment to accessible luxury. A refined single-tone purple dial takes center stage, introducing a distinctive character and renewed visual depth to an iconic timepiece. The vertically brushed center creates a quiet contrast with the matte outer ring, paying homage to the original mid-century models while adding a contemporary touch. Applied luminous Arabic numerals and indexes ensure enhanced legibility at all hours. The 40 mm stainless-steel case reveals the Delbana customized automatic movement through the transparent case back. Complete with a scratch resistant domed sapphire crystal and stainless steel bracelet, the Rotonda’s quality is tactile.

watches.name: Della Balda
watches.description: DESCRIPTION The Della Balda collection embodies the vision of Delbana’s founder, Goliardo Della Balda, uniting craftsmanship, design and exceptional value. The stainless-steel yellow gold PVD case features a refined champagne sunray guilloché pattern dial with coordinating applied indexes and Arabic numerals. A distinctive red arrow seconds hand and luminous markers provide character and functionality, while the date display at 3 o’clock adds a practical detail. The Delbana crest at 12 o’clock pays tribute to brands heritage. Paired with a brown handmade leather strap and protected by a domed sapphire crystal, it blends vintage appeal with modern durability. The transparent case back displays the Swiss Made automatic SW200-1 movement in this enduring expression of Delbana’s watchmaking legacy.
